title: The Frosting That Had to Set
youtube_title: The Frosting That Had to Set | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Chioma wants to check on a tray of tiny cakes whose frosting had to set before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Chioma leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
